faq.q: What does a good friend do?
faq.a: A good friend is kind, listens, takes turns, keeps promises, says sorry when they get it wrong, and is happy when good things happen to you.
asks: Tell me about the Good friend

faq.q: What does a good friend say when you mess up?
faq.a: Something kind and hopeful, like: Good try, or: It is okay, everyone makes mistakes. Kind words help you feel brave enough to try again.
asks: What do you say when your friend makes a mistake?

faq.q: What if my friend is not being friendly?
faq.a: Tell them calmly how you feel: I did not like it when you laughed at me. If it keeps happening, spend time with kinder friends and talk to a grown-up you trust.
asks: Tell me about the Not so friendly
My friend is mean to me

faq.a: Yes. Even best friends disagree sometimes. Good friends talk it through, say sorry and make up.
asks: Is it normal to fight with friends?

faq.q: How many friends do I need?
faq.a: There is no right number. Some people like lots of friends, others like one or two close ones. What matters most is that your friends are kind.
asks: Is it okay to have only one friend?

facts: Research by the psychologist Robin Dunbar suggests most people have an inner circle of about five very close friends.
In India and some other countries, Friendship Day is celebrated on the first Sunday of August, often by tying friendship bands.
